messages:
Nora Kim: quick check on HarborLine onboarding health. p95 up ~35ms on chat, token cost +17%. AM says renewal is flagged 'watch' unless we present a clear cost/latency plan. proposing: 1) run int8 AWQ pilot on non-sensitive intents, 2) swap to compact model family for summary/recap flows, 3) route heavy traffic to dedicated pool during peak hours with pre-warm. thoughts?
Diego Alvarez: agree. split intents: auth/payments = no quant, receipts/summaries/faq = candidate. suggest micro-canary (24-48h) with AB eval + small human spot-check.
Sam Patel: for compact swap, recommend trying kestrel-1.5-compact first; in infra tests latency dropped ~15-20% vs kestrel-2.0 full. watch for extraction regressions on long receipts. add similarity-based fallback to full model.
Nora Kim: good call. need warmup plan — cold KV is usually the culprit for p95 blips when changing models.
Sam Patel: plan: pre-warm dedicated pool 10-20 minutes before traffic shift, synthetic ramp for 10 minutes, KV-prefetch for top 60 prefixes. add ops alert if p95 > baseline + 20ms during ramp.
Diego Alvarez: rollback thresholds proposal: answer_similarity_drop > 0.03 OR user_error_rate_increase > 0.005 OR p95_latency_increase > 0.12 -> rollback. capture token_cost_delta and embedding stability.
Nora Kim: can someone draft a compact canary config? want explicit eval set + metrics. then I'll prepare customer enablement note with conservative savings estimate to cite in renewal (~7-11%).
Sam Patel: here's a config snippet to reuse:
```yaml
canary:
  name: harborline-int8-compact-canary
  candidates: [kestrel-1.5-compact-int8, kestrel-1.5-compact-awq]
  schedule: [0.03, 0.10, 0.25]
  eval_prompts: ["receipt_extract_short","faq_lookup","summary_medium"]
  metrics: [p95_latency, answer_similarity_cosine, token_cost_pct, user_error_rate]
  rollback_if:
    - answer_similarity_cosine_drop>0.03
    - user_error_rate_increase>0.005
    - p95_latency_increase>0.12
```
Diego Alvarez: I'll own running the canary and capturing eval metrics + human spot-check (50 queries). Nora: can you draft the renewal slide + customer note?
Nora Kim: yes — I'll make a succinct customer note explaining expected savings, rollback plan, and 30-day checkpoint before renewal discussion.
ops-bot: reminder set: HarborLine_canary_check at 2864790000. page if rollback criteria met.
Sam Patel: I'll implement warmup hooks and KV-prefetch on the dedicated pool; also add a short warm traffic generator for first 15 minutes of each ramp.
Diego Alvarez: action items: @Diego run canary & evals, @Sam warmup + routing, @Nora prepare customer enablement + renewal slide. update CS healthboard after first 24h. :thumbsup:
Nora Kim: ack.
Sam Patel: on it.
